question: Which wallets can I use with Stellar, and which have been renamed recently?

golden.answer: Stellar wallets include Varial (SDF's wallet, renamed from Freighter on 2026-10-29), LOBSTR, xBull, Albedo, Rabet, Hana and Hot Wallet, available as browser extensions, web and mobile apps; the Stellar Wallets Kit integrates them. Treat any list as a dated, non-exhaustive snapshot and check a wallet's current availability before recommending it.

truth.notes:
GROUNDED 2026-06-25: Lumen Loop / Scout directory wallet records confirm Freighter, Lobstr, Hana, xBull, with StellarTerm + Hot Wallet as adjacent options. Enumerating wallets the directory tracks → scout_projects (free-text directory); lumenloop_search_directory acceptable. Trap = fabricating wallet names or routing to general-web. List is curated, not exhaustive and should be treated as freshness-sensitive.
Also good if the answer: Distinguishes wallet types (browser-extension vs mobile vs multi-wallet kits) where the directory supports it.
Golden cites: The Stellar project directory (scout_projects / lumenloop directory) entries for wallets.
GT-20 CORRECTION 2026-07-10: grade pagination, exact-type filtering, generatedAt/count/source provenance, duplicate handling, and status-versus-availability separation. Never require a frozen roster/count.
RENAME (verified 2026-11-02): SDF renamed the Freighter wallet to Varial on 2026-10-29 (stellar.org blog "Freighter is now Varial"; extension 5.50.0 is the first Varial release). Freighter and Varial name the same SDF wallet; do not penalize either name. As of 2026-11-02 the Scout and Lumenloop records are still slug `freighter`, name Freighter; an answer that names this wallet Freighter, Varial, or both is not wrong.
2026-11-05 scoped rename recheck: Scout now resolves both Freighter and Varial to the same wallet, slug freighter, current name Varial, with Freighter as a former-name alias, the October 29 rename date and varialwallet.com website. Lumenloop still describes the freighter record as Freighter and does not return the wallet for the new name (ll-032). This repairs the Scout identity lag only; the November 2 wallet roster and counts above remain historical observations, not newly verified totals.
Reporting a wallet's dated Scout lifecycle label, or Scout's separate per-platform availability records, as attributed observations does not fire the availability avoid; it fires only when a Live label is itself offered as proof of current app availability.
